question: How should a video's Library let you pick a kind of thing (title pages, name cards, backgrounds...)?
context: Built: chips. The Library in a video now has Media and Catalog only; the catalog groups everything made for video by kind. This card only asks how the kinds are picked.

options.label: Chips that wrap above the tiles (built)
options.summary: A row of small pills under the search box, one per kind with its count, plus All; they wrap to a second line in a narrow dock. Click one and the tiles below show only that kind.
pros: Every kind and its count is readable at a glance
Tiles keep the whole width of the dock
cons: Takes two lines of the dock above the tiles
options.mitigation: Kinds with nothing in them have no chip, so the row stays short.

options.label: A column of kinds down the left of the tiles
options.summary: A narrow list of kinds (Title Pages, Name Cards, ...) runs down the left edge of the Library, like the Finder sidebar; the tiles fill the space to its right.
pros: Familiar from Final Cut title browser and the Finder sidebar
Adds no lines above the tiles
cons: In a 300 point dock the tiles shrink to one narrow column
Long kind names get cut off
options.mitigation: The column could fold to icons when the dock is narrow.

options.label: One dropdown naming the kind
options.summary: A single pop-up button above the tiles reads All, or Title Pages and so on; pick from it to change the kind.
cons: You cannot see what kinds exist or how many without opening it
Two clicks to change kind instead of one
options.mitigation: The dropdown can show the count beside each kind.

answer.note: Taken as recommended: the user, 2026-10-19, said there were too many cards, most did not matter and they could not follow them. Change it later only if they complain about the result
